scope: Synthetic one-layer attention with Mistral 7B v0.3 head and workspace dimensions. A seeded native model exercises full single-row prefill against a per-head batch reference.
primary: BenchmarkSharedKVFourHeads with 120 iterations per sample and count 3. Run reference-first/shared-second/shared-first/reference-second for each shape. Retain raw timings and compare medians across both orders.
numerical_gate: Match every output bit against the per-head kernel. Preserve lane count and activation buffer sizes. Exercise split score slots, partial pages, both formats, and full single-row prefill against batched prefill.
timing_gate: Require shared/reference median ratios at most 0.90 at 1024 and 4096 for both formats. Record 128 as a forced-kernel diagnostic.
compatibility: Use the baseline three-head benchmark source in both builds. Select the baseline and current monolith through source overlays. Measure 180 iterations per sample in reference/candidate/candidate/reference/candidate/reference/reference/candidate process order. Require median adjacent-pair ratios at most 1.05 at 1024 and 4096 for FP32 and FP16. Retain every sample.
